question: Find the value of 40 – [20 – {14 – (16 – 6 × 4 – 2)}].
solution:
**Given:**

40 – [20 – {14 – (16 – 6 × 4 &
amp;ndash; 2)}]

**Concept/Formula Used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e54636ed411e889d1916f3aa2f06c5b9166f427a3a8425c3cbc9a3f3f9273545.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ 40 – [20 – {14 – (16 – 24 – 2)}]

⇒ 40 – [20 – {14 – (-10)}]

⇒ 40 – [20 - 24] = 40 – [-4]

⇒ 40 + 4 = 44.

**Therefore, the value of the given expression is 44.**
